trailhead.label: Lago Santo car park, Cembra, the APT’s start

cautions: Grassy and compacted lakeside paths, a little muddy after rain.
Busy with bathers in summer: keep your dog close on the beach.
Dogs may not go into the water except in the signed dog-bathing area just north of the Rio Mercar outlet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
